.github/workflows/clued-cloud-node22-ins.source_yaml:
name: clued-cloud-node22-install

# apps/clued-cloud declares engines node >=22.22.0, but every other workflow
# installs on Node 24 (npm 11). npm 10 validates the lockfile more strictly,
# so a lockfile that npm 11 accepts can still fail `npm ci` on Node 22.
# This job installs on the declared engines floor to catch that drift.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/clued-cloud-node22-install.yml'
      - 'apps/clued-cloud/package.json'
      - 'apps/clued-cloud/package-lock.json'
      - 'apps/clued-cloud/.npmrc'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/clued-cloud-node22-install.yml'
      - 'apps/clued-cloud/package.json'
      - 'apps/clued-cloud/package-lock.json'
      - 'apps/clued-cloud/.npmrc'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Work Claim Admission v0.1 §4.6 L0b: the heavy jobs below run only when
  # Clued admits this pull request. The gate does not call Clued and gets no
  # Clued token (this job runs PR code): it waits for the trusted
  # pull_request_target run of clued-work-admission.yml on this head and reads
  # its result, always enforced (Merge Admission step 6 retired the advisory
  # switch CLUED_WORK_ADMISSION_ENFORCE); non-PR events are admitted.
  # Self-hosted Linux pool, pinned Node (Decision f86179b3).
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  trusted-self-hosted:
    name: >-
      ${{ (((github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
              github.actor == github.repository_owner)))
          && 'clued-cloud-node22-install' || 'clued-cloud-node22-install-self-hosted-skipped' }}
    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner))
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 22.22.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - run: node --version && npm --version
      - name: Install from lockfile on the engines floor
        run: >-
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15s 8m
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --cache "$HOME/.npm" --prefer-offline
          --fetch-retries=2 --fetch-timeout=30000

  untrusted-hosted:
    name: >-
      ${{ (((github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
               github.actor != github.repository_owner))))
          && 'clued-cloud-node22-install' || 'clued-cloud-node22-install-hosted-skipped' }}
    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
        github.actor != github.repository_owner)))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 22.22.0
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/clued-cloud/package-lock.json
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - run: node --version && npm --version
      - name: Install from lockfile on the engines floor
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts

name: clued-cloud-quality

# Lint, migration ledger, typecheck, build and unit tests of apps/clued-cloud
# (npm run lint, npm run ledger:verify, npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm
# run test:unit) on every pull request and
# every push to main; the build comes first because tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
# reads the built server bundle.
# Ordinary documentation gets a scoped check without application installs/tests;
# unknown, code, dependency, config and governance changes still run the full suite.
# This workflow deliberately has no paths filter: the other app checks are
# path-filtered, so none of them can be a required status check, while this
# one can be added to the main ruleset's required checks under the single
# check name clued-cloud-quality. The gate job is the shared admission gate
# (Work Claim Admission v0.1 §4.6 L0b). Audit 2026-10-06, Task 5077b641.

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Work Claim Admission v0.1 §4.6 L0b: the heavy jobs below run only when
  # Clued admits this pull request. The gate does not call Clued and gets no
  # Clued token (this job runs PR code): it waits for the trusted
  # pull_request_target run of clued-work-admission.yml on this head and reads
  # its result, always enforced (Merge Admission step 6 retired the advisory
  # switch CLUED_WORK_ADMISSION_ENFORCE); non-PR events are admitted.
  # Self-hosted Linux pool, pinned Node (Decision f86179b3).
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  trusted-self-hosted:
    name: >-
      ${{ (((github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
              github.actor == github.repository_owner)))
          && 'clued-cloud-quality' || 'clued-cloud-quality-self-hosted-skipped' }}
    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner))
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Qualify ordinary documentation changes
        id: classify
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: .
        env:
          TMPDIR: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TEMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-pycache
          WRANGLER_LOG_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-wrangler-logs
        run: |
          python3 scripts/ci/test_clued_docs_only.py
          python3 scripts/ci/clued-docs-only.py
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Install from lockfile
        id: install
        if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        env:
          # Debug logs only; npm's existing cache and command stay the same.
          npm_config_logs_dir: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-npm-debug-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
        run: >-
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15s 8m
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --cache "$HOME/.npm" --prefer-offline
          --fetch-retries=2 --fetch-timeout=30000
      - name: Observe npm HTTP cache events
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && (steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false') }}
        env:
          npm_config_logs_dir: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-npm-debug-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          NPM_INSTALL_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.install.outcome }}
        run: node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/npm-cache-observation.mjs"
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run lint
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run ledger:verify
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run typecheck
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run build
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run test:unit

  untrusted-hosted:
    name: >-
      ${{ (((github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
               github.actor != github.repository_owner))))
          && 'clued-cloud-quality' || 'clued-cloud-quality-hosted-skipped' }}
    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
        github.actor != github.repository_owner)))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - name: Qualify ordinary documentation changes
        id: classify
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: .
        env:
          TMPDIR: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          TEMP: ${{ runner.temp }}
          PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-pycache
          WRANGLER_LOG_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-wrangler-logs
        run: |
          python3 scripts/ci/test_clued_docs_only.py
          python3 scripts/ci/clued-docs-only.py
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
          cache: ${{ (steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false') && 'npm' || '' }}
          cache-dependency-path: apps/clued-cloud/package-lock.json
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Install from lockfile
        if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run lint
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run ledger:verify
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run typecheck
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run build
      - if: steps.classify.outcome != 'success' || steps.classify.outputs.run_full != 'false'
        run: npm run test:unit

permissions:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}

jobs:

  # Clued token (this job runs PR code): it waits for the trusted
  # pull_request_target run of clued-work-admission.yml on this head and reads
  # its result, always enforced (Merge Admission step 6 retired the advisory
  # switch CLUED_WORK_ADMISSION_ENFORCE). A hand dispatch needs
  # admission_run_id from clued-work-admission-dispatch.yml; push events are
  # admitted. Self-hosted Linux pool, pinned Node (Decision f86179b3).
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  push-reuse:
    name: Verify prior PR tested tree
    needs: admission-gate
    if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'push')
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      run_heavy: ${{ steps.reuse.outputs.run_heavy }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Verify duplicate-push proof regressions
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: node --test scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.test.mjs
      - id: reuse

        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REUSE_WORKFLOW: clued-connection-authorization.yml
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.mjs

    needs: [admission-gate, push-reuse]

      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&

       (github.event_name != 'push' || needs.push-reuse.result != 'success' ||
        needs.push-reuse.outputs.run_heavy != 'false') &&
      ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner)))
    name: >-
      ${{ ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
              github.actor == github.repository_owner))
          && 'isolated-candidate' || 'isolated-candidate-self-hosted-skipped' }}
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]

    defaults:

        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud

      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020

      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --cache "$HOME/.npm" --prefer-offline
      - name: Hydrate embedded PostgreSQL bundled library symlinks
        # --ignore-scripts skips the platform package's postinstall, which links the
        # bundled libpq.so.5 and libicu*.so.60 that the binaries load via $ORIGIN/../lib.
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud/node_modules/@embedded-postgres/linux-x64
        run: |
          node scripts/hydrate-symlinks.js
          ./native/bin/initdb --version
          ./native/bin/postgres --version
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run test:authorization:transport
      - run: npm run test:authorization:database
      - run: npm run test:context:v2
      - run: npm run test:projection:refresh
      - run: npm run test:work:claims
      - run: node --test --test-force-exit tests/work-claims-acceptance-db.test.mjs
      - run: node --test --test-force-exit tests/work-claims-continuation-db.test.mjs
      # Without --test-force-exit, which can end a loaded run before every test has run: this
      # file stops its embedded PostgreSQL servers itself, so node exits once the tests are done.
      - run: node --test tests/db-security-hygiene-db.test.mjs
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:candidates
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:intake
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:promotion
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:context
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:invalidation
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:hardening
      - run: npm run test:records:db
      - run: npm run test:mtpe:intake
      - run: npm run test:production:release-gate
      - run: npm run test:integration-runtime:gate-evidence
      # IntegrationRuntime §17 item 2: every S2c suite runs once, here, through the gate evidence
      # generator, which fails the step unless G-A3/7/8/9/10/11 are all PASS and every test passed.
      - name: S2c gate evidence
        env:
          CLUED_EVIDENCE_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: npm run integration-runtime:gate-evidence -- --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/integration-runtime-gate-evidence.json"
      - name: Upload S2c gate evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: integration-runtime-gate-evidence-self-hosted
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/integration-runtime-gate-evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - run: npm run test:authorization:invitations
      - run: npm run test:authorization:migrations
      - run: npm run test:resource-center:authority
      - run: npm run test:authorization:integration
      - run: npm run test:authorization:pages

      - name: Record the actual PR test tree

        env:
          REUSE_WORKFLOW: clued-connection-authorization.yml
          REUSE_REPORT_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-tested-tree.json
        run: node ../../scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.mjs --report
      - name: Upload the actual PR test tree
        if: success() && github.event_name == 'pull_request'

          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-tested-tree.json

    name: >-

             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
               github.actor != github.repository_owner)))
          && 'isolated-candidate' || 'isolated-candidate-hosted-skipped' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25

      run:

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683

      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Install embedded PostgreSQL ICU compatibility runtime
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          ldconfig -p | grep 'libicuuc.so.60'
      - run: npm run typecheck

      - run: npm run test:authorization:database

      - run: npm run test:projection:refresh
      - run: npm run test:work:claims
      - run: node --test --test-force-exit tests/work-claims-acceptance-db.test.mjs

      - run: npm run test:information-flow:hardening
      - run: npm run test:records:db

      - run: npm run test:production:release-gate
      - run: npm run test:integration-runtime:gate-evidence
      # IntegrationRuntime §17 item 2: every S2c suite runs once, here, through the gate evidence

          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  push-reuse:
    name: Verify prior PR tested tree
    needs: admission-gate
    if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'push')
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      run_heavy: ${{ steps.reuse.outputs.run_heavy }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3

        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage

        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: node --test scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.test.mjs

        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REUSE_WORKFLOW: clued-connection-authorization.yml
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.mjs

    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&

       (github.event_name != 'push' || needs.push-reuse.result != 'success' ||
        needs.push-reuse.outputs.run_heavy != 'false') &&

       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner)))
    name: >-
      ${{ ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
              github.actor == github.repository_owner))

      - run: npm run test:authorization:transport
      - run: npm run test:authorization:database
      - run: npm run test:context:v2
      - run: npm run test:projection:refresh
      - run: npm run test:work:claims
      - run: node --test --test-force-exit tests/work-claims-acceptance-db.test.mjs
      - run: node --test --test-force-exit tests/work-claims-continuation-db.test.mjs

      - run: node --test tests/db-security-hygiene-db.test.mjs

      - run: npm run test:information-flow:intake
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:promotion
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:context
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:invalidation
      - run: npm run test:information-flow:hardening
      - run: npm run test:records:db
      - run: npm run test:mtpe:intake
      - run: npm run test:production:release-gate

       github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&

             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||

  admission-gate:

      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}

          icu_deb=$(mktemp "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-libicu60-XXXXXX.deb")

      - run: npm run test:authorization:migrations
      - run: npm run test:resource-center:authority

        run: |
          node scripts/run-tests.mjs --test \
            tests/dataset-split-native-grant-binding-successor-db.test.mjs \
            tests/dataset-split-native-grant-correction-db.test.mjs \
            tests/dataset-split-native-grant-currentness-scope-db.test.mjs

    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]

      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read

      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}

      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: read

      run_heavy: ${{ steps.reuse.outputs.run_heavy }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        if: github.event_name == 'push'

      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      (!cancelled() && needs.admission-gate.result == 'success' &&
       (github.event_name != 'push' || needs.push-reuse.result != 'success' ||
        needs.push-reuse.outputs.run_heavy != 'false') &&

       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner)))

    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-docker-linux]
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
          # Self-hosted runners keep a persistent ~/.npm that npm ci reuses below;
          # restoring the ~860 MB Actions cache on top of it only adds download time.

      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage

        # CPU bindings are bundled; G4 does not need the optional CUDA binaries.
        env:
          ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL: 'skip'
        run: npm ci --cache "$HOME/.npm" --prefer-offline

        run: npm run build

      - name: Verify fresh-start guard regressions
        run: node --test ../../scripts/ci/clued-g4-fresh-start.test.mjs

      - name: Prepare a fresh attempt-specific Supabase project
        run: node ../../scripts/ci/clued-g4-fresh-start.mjs --prepare

      - name: Start isolated Supabase runtime
        run: npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase start

      - name: Verify fresh migration initialization
        # start applies the complete migration chain once to a proven empty project.
        run: node ../../scripts/ci/clued-g4-fresh-start.mjs --verify

      - name: Lint public and private database schemas
        run: npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase db lint --local --schema public,clued_private --level error --fail-on error

      - name: Run Unified Record V2 RLS and transaction tests
        run: npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase test db supabase/tests/m1_runtime_contracts.test.sql supabase/tests/m1_legacy_mapping.test.sql --local

      - name: Run Project Lifecycle Successor v2 database and surface tests
        run: npm run test:project:lifecycle:v2

      - name: Verify measurement journal transactions and FIFO replay
        run: |
          node scripts/run-tests.mjs --test tests/merge-admission-measurement-history-db.test.mjs
          node --test ../../scripts/ci/merge-admission-measurement-history.test.mjs

      - name: Capture safe failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        run: |
          docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}'
          docker system df

      - name: Stop isolated Supabase runtime
        if: always() && env.CLUED_G4_FRESH_PROJECT != ''
        run: |
          node ../../scripts/ci/clued-g4-fresh-start.mjs --guard-cleanup
          # The CLI may return nonzero while pruning unrelated containers on
          # this persistent runner. The gate still requires this run's isolated
          # runtime to be stopped; Docker errors must not be mistaken for clean.
          npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase stop --no-backup || stop_status=$?

          if grep -Eq "^supabase_.*_${CLUED_G4_FRESH_PROJECT}$" <<< "$running"; then

          fi

        if: success() && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          REUSE_WORKFLOW: clued-g4-database.yml
          REUSE_REPORT_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-tested-tree.json
        run: node ../../scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.mjs --report
      - name: Upload the actual PR test tree
        if: success() && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: clued-tested-tree-clued-g4-database.yml-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/clued-tested-tree.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 7

  database-gate-untrusted-hosted:
    needs: [admission-gate, push-reuse]
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      (!cancelled() && needs.admission-gate.result == 'success' &&
       (github.event_name != 'push' || needs.push-reuse.result != 'success' ||
        needs.push-reuse.outputs.run_heavy != 'false') &&
      ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
       github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
        github.actor != github.repository_owner))))
    name: Supabase migration, RLS, transaction, and pgTAP (hosted)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/clued-cloud/package-lock.json

      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Install application dependencies
        # CPU bindings are bundled; G4 does not need the optional CUDA binaries.
        env:
          ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL: 'skip'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build the application surfaces used by lifecycle tests
        run: npm run build

      - name: Verify fresh-start guard regressions

    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0

        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  push-reuse:
    name: Verify prior PR tested tree
    needs: admission-gate
    if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'push')
    # Main-only reuse verification executes merged code without environment secrets.
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      run_heavy: ${{ steps.reuse.outputs.run_heavy }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Verify duplicate-push proof regressions
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: node --test scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.test.mjs
      - id: reuse
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REUSE_WORKFLOW: clued-g4-database.yml
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.mjs

    needs: [admission-gate, push-reuse]
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      (!cancelled() && needs.admission-gate.result == 'success' &&
       (github.event_name != 'push' || needs.push-reuse.result != 'success' ||
        needs.push-reuse.outputs.run_heavy != 'false') &&

       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||

name: contract-placement

# Task af536fcc; ComponentVersioning.v0.2 §2.4. Always a real hosted conclusion.
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  contract-placement:
    name: contract-placement
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Placement and renderer fixtures
        run: |
          python3 -m unittest scripts/ci/test_check_contract_placement.py -v
          node --test apps/clued-cloud/tests/agent-contract-bootstrap.test.mjs
      - name: Build actual public bootstrap without the application dependency tree
        env:
          CANDIDATE: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-build" --no-save --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts esbuild@0.28.1
          node "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-build/node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild" apps/clued-cloud/worker/continuity.ts \
            --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:js-tiktoken/* \
            --define:__CLUED_BUILD_SHA__="\"$CANDIDATE\"" --outfile="$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-bootstrap.mjs"
      - name: Render all actual and synthetic contract parts
        run: node apps/clued-cloud/scripts/render-agent-contract-budget.mjs --worker-module "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-bootstrap.mjs" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-responses.json"
      - name: Enforce placement and one-time production gate
        env:
          BASE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          CANDIDATE: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: python3 scripts/ci/check_contract_placement.py --base "$BASE" --head "$CANDIDATE" --minimum-service-version 0.4.5 --rendered-responses "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-responses.json"

      - id: gate

        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage

        run: |
          python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p test_check_contract_placement.py -v
          node --test apps/clued-cloud/tests/agent-contract-bootstrap.test.mjs
      - name: Build actual public bootstrap without the application dependency tree
        env:
          CANDIDATE: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/contract-build" --no-save --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts esbuild@0.28.1

            --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:js-tiktoken/* \

          node-version: 24.19.0

        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage

        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

    name: >-
      ${{ ((github.event_name == 'push' &&
                     github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
                    (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
                     github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
                     github.actor == github.repository_owner))
          && 'design-refs' || 'design-refs-self-hosted-skipped' }}
    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner))

      - run: python3 scripts/ci/check_design_refs.py

    name: >-

                     github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
                    (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
                     (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||

    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
        github.actor != github.repository_owner)))
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage

      - run: python3 scripts/ci/check_design_refs.py

  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

  gitleaks-trusted-self-hosted:
    timeout-minutes: 25
    name: >-
      ${{ (((github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||

              github.actor == github.repository_owner)))
          && 'gitleaks' || 'gitleaks-self-hosted-skipped' }}

name: gitleaks

# Owner Decisions 325717a6, 22b0e0ed and bc6fdad1: the scan runs on a GitHub-hosted runner with free
# minutes under the $0 Actions budget cap as an executor only. Its job name is not a required check
# name; App 5368905 publishes the required gitleaks check after it verifies this run's relay identity,
# and otherwise runs its formal local role.
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
      automation_self_hosted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      # Owner Decision 22b0e0ed: admit on the independent CI's own App 5368905 kooyumi-work-admission
      # check for this exact head, polled for at most 10 minutes; never on another App's check.
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CLUED_ADMISSION_GATE_SOURCE: independent-ci-native-work-admission
          CLUED_ADMISSION_GATE_WAIT_SECONDS: "600"
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  gitleaks-trusted-self-hosted:
    needs: admission-gate
    timeout-minutes: 25
    name: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true'))) && 'gitleaks-hosted-executor' || 'gitleaks-hosted-executor-skipped' }}
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository && (github.actor == github.repository_owner || needs.admission-gate.outputs.automation_self_hosted == 'true')))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      # The trusted base only: the pinned .gitleaks.toml, the reviewed-finding helper and the
      # temporary-storage action come from main, never from the pull request.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      # Exactly the input of the local formal role (worker/formal-gitleaks-v4/required-history/
      # prepare.mjs): a fresh Git directory with no checkout, holding the fresh remote heads and tags,
      # the detached current head and the pinned reviewed commits (objects only, never refs), with
      # only the pinned .gitleaks.toml beside it. No .gitattributes, .gitleaksignore or other file of
      # the pull request is read: the scan sees history as data, with no attributes of any tree.
      - name: Prepare the required history
        env:
          FETCH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || '' }}
        run: |
          set -eu
          umask 022
          export LC_ALL=C GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1
          scan="$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-gitleaks"; repo="$scan/repo"; control="$scan/control"
          mkdir "$scan" "$repo" "$control"
          echo "cf631812810d997f42496af561f44930b51087737f146c4a7541c5dbc0a994cd  .gitleaks.toml" | sha256sum -c --quiet -
          echo "433b24137a7d3430990b69e61c0b4ebcd9dad47d770c5df62d6e1fef28b7f7a9  scripts/ci/reviewed_gitleaks.py" | sha256sum -c --quiet -
          sed -n 's/^# clued-reviewed-finding: {"fingerprint":"\([0-9a-f]\{40\}\):.*$/\1/p' .gitleaks.toml | sort -u > "$control/reviewed-commits"
          echo "fcb2cc04ee35e01fbfc4bfc3dc9b0bb0ba78a6c4083ab5e17433c549450d59bb  $control/reviewed-commits" | sha256sum -c --quiet -
          git init --quiet --template= "$repo"
          auth="$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$FETCH_TOKEN" | base64 -w0)"
          fetch() {
            GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=http.https://github.com/.extraheader GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="AUTHORIZATION: basic $auth" \
              git -C "$repo" -c core.logAllRefUpdates=false -c core.hooksPath=/nonexistent-clued-hooks -c protocol.allow=never \
              -c protocol.https.allow=always fetch --quiet --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules --no-auto-gc --update-head-ok \
              "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$@"
          }
          fetch '+refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*' '+refs/tags/*:refs/tags/*'
          fetch "$HEAD_SHA" "$GITHUB_SHA" $(cat "$control/reviewed-commits")
          rm -f "$repo/.git/FETCH_HEAD"
          git -C "$repo" -c core.logAllRefUpdates=false update-ref --no-deref HEAD "$HEAD_SHA"
          test "$(git -C "$repo" cat-file -t "$HEAD_SHA")" = commit
          # The scanned head is the second parent of the merge commit this run belongs to.
          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" != pull_request || test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify --quiet "$GITHUB_SHA^2")" = "$HEAD_SHA"
          test -z "$BASE_SHA" || test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          test "$(git -C "$repo" cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype)' < "$control/reviewed-commits" | sort -u)" = commit
          test -z "$(git -C "$repo" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' | grep -Ev '^refs/(heads|tags)/' || true)"
          for indirect in shallow info/grafts objects/info/alternates objects/info/http-alternates logs; do test ! -e "$repo/.git/$indirect"; done
          git -C "$repo" fsck --full --strict --no-reflogs --no-progress
          install -m 0444 .gitleaks.toml "$repo/.gitleaks.toml"
          printf '[safe]\n\tdirectory = /repo\n\tdirectory = /test\n' > "$control/git-safe.config"
          chmod -R a+rX "$repo" && chmod 0444 "$control/git-safe.config"
      - name: Validate exact historical exceptions and detection regressions
        run: |
          python3 -I -B scripts/ci/reviewed_gitleaks.py \
            --config "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-gitleaks/repo/.gitleaks.toml" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-gitleaks/control/reviewed.ignore" \
            --self-test
      # The local role's container (worker/verify-once/verify-worker.mjs createArguments) and argv
      # (prepare.mjs SCAN_ARGS), with the exact reviewed ignore file that its self-test accepts.
      - name: Scan complete history with Gitleaks 8.30.1
        run: |
          set -eu
          scan="$RUNNER_TEMP/clued-gitleaks"
          image=ghcr.io/gitleaks/gitleaks:v8.30.1@sha256:c00b6bd0aeb3071cbcb79009cb16a60dd9e0a7c60e2be9ab65d25e6bc8abbb7f
          echo "d599f6b9733e68370f7353114600f9939d675202de828d68cc761f3153aa2abe  $scan/control/reviewed.ignore" | sha256sum -c --quiet -
          chmod 0444 "$scan/control/reviewed.ignore"
          docker pull --quiet "$image" > /dev/null
          docker run --rm --pull=never --network=none --ipc=private --cgroupns=private --user=65532:65532 --read-only \
            --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges:true --pids-limit=128 --cpus=2 --memory=2147483648 \
            --memory-swap=2147483648 --ulimit=nofile=1024:1024 --env=NODE_OPTIONS= --env=NODE_PATH= --env=HOME=/scratch \
            --tmpfs=/scratch:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,size=536870912,mode=0700,uid=65532,gid=65532 \
            --mount "type=bind,src=$scan/repo,dst=/repo,readonly,bind-propagation=rprivate" \
            --mount "type=bind,src=$scan/control/reviewed.ignore,dst=/reviewed.ignore,readonly,bind-propagation=rprivate" \
            --mount "type=bind,src=$scan/control/git-safe.config,dst=/etc/gitconfig,readonly,bind-propagation=rprivate" \
            --workdir=/repo --entrypoint /usr/bin/gitleaks "$image" \
            git /repo --config /repo/.gitleaks.toml --gitleaks-ignore-path /reviewed.ignore --redact --exit-code 1
      - name: Emit relay identity
        run: |
          set -eu
          jwt="$(curl -fsS --max-time 30 -H "Authorization: bearer $ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN" \
            "$ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL&audience=clued-hosted-relay-v1" \
            | python3 -I -B -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["value"])')"
          echo "::notice title=clued-hosted-relay-v1::$jwt"

name: Information Flow M0-D E2E

# Contract development/contracts/information-flow/M0DCloseout.v0.1.md section 7
# and gates M0D-B06..B08. Runs the S6 harness over the real local Worker
# (workerd via Miniflare) and the full local Supabase stack (Kong, PostgREST,
# GoTrue, PostgreSQL with the full migration chain). Local qualification only:
# no production access, no deploy, no model or provider calls. The evidence is
# uploaded as a CI artifact for the reproducibility cross-check; committed
# evidence comes from the reviewed local run.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      admission_run_id:
        description: Id of a successful clued-work-admission-dispatch run that admitted this workflow and ref
        required: false
        type: string
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/information-flow-e2e.yml
      - 'scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.mjs'
      - 'scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.test.mjs'
      - 'scripts/ci/clued-g4-fresh-start.mjs'
      - 'scripts/ci/clued-g4-fresh-start.test.mjs'
      - apps/clued-cloud/supabase/migrations/**
      - apps/clued-cloud/worker/**
      - apps/clued-cloud/evals/information-flow-e2e/**
      - apps/clued-cloud/evals/public-mcp/worker.ts
      - apps/clued-cloud/tests/information-flow-*.test.mjs
      - development/contracts/information-flow/**
      - apps/clued-cloud/package.json
      - apps/clued-cloud/package-lock.json
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/information-flow-e2e.yml
      - 'scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.mjs'
      - 'scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.test.mjs'
      - 'scripts/ci/clued-g4-fresh-start.mjs'
      - 'scripts/ci/clued-g4-fresh-start.test.mjs'
      - apps/clued-cloud/supabase/migrations/**
      - apps/clued-cloud/worker/**
      - apps/clued-cloud/evals/information-flow-e2e/**
      - apps/clued-cloud/evals/public-mcp/worker.ts
      - apps/clued-cloud/tests/information-flow-*.test.mjs
      - development/contracts/information-flow/**
      - apps/clued-cloud/package.json
      - apps/clued-cloud/package-lock.json

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Work Claim Admission v0.1 §4.6 L0b: the heavy jobs below run only when
  # Clued admits this pull request. The gate does not call Clued and gets no
  # Clued token (this job runs PR code): it waits for the trusted
  # pull_request_target run of clued-work-admission.yml on this head and reads
  # its result, always enforced (Merge Admission step 6 retired the advisory
  # switch CLUED_WORK_ADMISSION_ENFORCE). A hand dispatch needs
  # admission_run_id from clued-work-admission-dispatch.yml; push events are
  # admitted. Self-hosted Linux pool, pinned Node (Decision f86179b3).
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  push-reuse:
    name: Verify prior PR tested tree
    needs: admission-gate
    if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'push')
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      run_heavy: ${{ steps.reuse.outputs.run_heavy }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          node-version: 22.23.3
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Verify duplicate-push proof regressions
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: node --test scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.test.mjs
      - id: reuse
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REUSE_WORKFLOW: information-flow-e2e.yml
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-push-reuse.mjs

  e2e-trusted-self-hosted:
    needs: [admission-gate, push-reuse]
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      (!cancelled() && needs.admission-gate.result == 'success' &&
       (github.event_name != 'push' || needs.push-reuse.result != 'success' ||
        needs.push-reuse.outputs.run_heavy != 'false') &&
      ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner)))
    name: Information Flow E2E over the local Worker and Supabase stack
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-docker-linux]
    timeout-minutes: 35
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud

    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
          # Self-hosted runners keep a persistent ~/.npm; no Actions npm cache.

      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Install application dependencies
        run: npm ci --cache "$HOME/.npm" --prefer-offline

      - name: Isolate local Supabase ports
        env:
          CLUED_IFE2E_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os
          import re
          from pathlib import Path

          run_id = int(os.environ['CLUED_IFE2E_RUN_ID'])
          port_base = 45000 + (run_id % 1000) * 10
          config = Path('supabase/config.toml')
          source = config.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          project = 'project_id = "clued-cloud"'
          if source.count(project) != 1:
              raise RuntimeError('Unexpected Supabase project ID')
          source = source.replace(project, f'project_id = "clued-ife2e-{run_id}"')
          source, count = re.subn(
              r'(?m)^([ \t]*(?:port|shadow_port)[ \t]*=[ \t]*)5432([0-9])$',
              lambda match: match.group(1) + str(port_base + int(match.group(2))),
              source,
          )
          if count != 7:
              raise RuntimeError(f'Expected seven Supabase ports, found {count}')
          config.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8')
          print(f'IF E2E Supabase project and ports isolated for run {run_id}')
          PY

      - name: Start the local Supabase stack (db, Kong, PostgREST, GoTrue)
        run: npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase start -x realtime,storage-api,imgproxy,mailpit,postgres-meta,studio,edge-runtime,logflare,vector,supavisor

      - name: Deny loopback proxy ports to the harness isolation guard
        run: |
          # Any loopback HTTP(S) proxy port is refused by the guard; "none" when
          # the runner has no loopback proxy (IFE2E_DENY_PORTS is recorded in run.json).
          ports=$(python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, urllib.parse
          out = set()
          for name in ('HTTPS_PROXY', 'https_proxy', 'HTTP_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'ALL_PROXY', 'all_proxy'):
              value = os.environ.get(name)

        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/clued-cloud/package-lock.json

      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Install application dependencies
        env:
          ONNXRUNTIME_NODE_INSTALL: 'skip'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Start the local Supabase stack (db, Kong, PostgREST, GoTrue)
        run: npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase start -x realtime,storage-api,imgproxy,mailpit,postgres-meta,studio,edge-runtime,logflare,vector,supavisor

      - name: Deny loopback proxy ports to the harness isolation guard
        run: |
          # Any loopback HTTP(S) proxy port is refused by the guard; "none" when
          # the runner has no loopback proxy (IFE2E_DENY_PORTS is recorded in run.json).
          ports=$(python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, urllib.parse
          out = set()
          for name in ('HTTPS_PROXY', 'https_proxy', 'HTTP_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'ALL_PROXY', 'all_proxy'):
              value = os.environ.get(name)
              if not value:
                  continue
              url = urllib.parse.urlparse(value if '://' in value else 'http://' + value)
              if url.hostname in ('127.0.0.1', 'localhost', '::1') and url.port:
                  out.add(str(url.port))
          print(','.join(sorted(out)) or 'none')
          PY
          )
          echo "IFE2E_DENY_PORTS=$ports" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Run the Information Flow E2E harness
        run: npm run test:information-flow:e2e -- --evidence-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/ife2e"

      - name: Recompute normalized evidence digests
        if: always()
        run: npm run information-flow:e2e:verify -- --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/ife2e"

      - name: Upload E2E evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: information-flow-e2e-evidence
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ife2e
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Capture safe failure diagnostics
        if: failure()
        run: |
          docker ps -a --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}'
          docker system df

      - name: Stop the local Supabase stack
        if: always()
        run: npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase stop --no-backup

name: public-mcp-behavior

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/public-mcp-*.yml'
      - 'apps/clued-cloud/**'
      - 'protocol/continuity/v1/**'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/public-mcp-*.yml'

      - 'protocol/continuity/v1/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Work Claim Admission v0.1 §4.6 L0b: the heavy jobs below run only when
  # Clued admits this pull request. The gate does not call Clued and gets no
  # Clued token (this job runs PR code): it waits for the trusted
  # pull_request_target run of clued-work-admission.yml on this head and reads
  # its result, always enforced (Merge Admission step 6 retired the advisory
  # switch CLUED_WORK_ADMISSION_ENFORCE); push events are admitted.
  # Self-hosted Linux pool, pinned Node (Decision f86179b3).
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  trusted-self-hosted:
    name: >-
      ${{ (((github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
              github.actor == github.repository_owner)))
          && 'public-mcp-behavior' || 'public-mcp-behavior-self-hosted-skipped' }}
    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && (
      (github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner))
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-docker-linux, site-company]
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud
    env:
      PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: "true"
      MCP_BEARER_TOKEN: clued_bnd_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
      MCP_NEG_OWNER_A_TOKEN: clued_bnd_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
      MCP_SESSION_TOKEN: clued_ses_cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
          # Self-hosted runners keep a persistent ~/.npm that npm ci reuses below;
          # restoring the ~860 MB Actions cache on top of it only adds download time.
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
        with:
          isolate-promptfoo: 'true'
      - run: npm ci --cache "$HOME/.npm" --prefer-offline --fetch-retries=5
      - name: Serialize fixed public MCP ports with other runners on this host
        run: |
          "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/self-hosted/host-port-lock.sh" acquire public-mcp-ports
      - name: Isolate this run's Supabase project and ports
        run: |
          node --test ../../scripts/ci/public-mcp-supabase-isolation.test.mjs
          node ../../scripts/ci/public-mcp-supabase-isolation.mjs prepare
      - run: npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase start
      - run: npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase db reset --local --no-seed
      - run: npm run mcp:isolated:fixture
      - name: Allocate a behavior-only loopback port
        run: |
          mcp_port="$(node evals/public-mcp/start-isolated.mjs allocate)"
          echo "MCP_ISOLATED_PORT=$mcp_port" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "MCP_ISOLATED_URL=http://127.0.0.1:$mcp_port/mcp" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Start isolated MCP
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          setsid node evals/public-mcp/start-isolated.mjs &
          node evals/public-mcp/start-isolated.mjs record "$!" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-mcp.pid"
          node evals/public-mcp/start-isolated.mjs ready "$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-mcp.pid")"
      - run: npm run mcp:eval:positive
      - run: npm run mcp:isolated:fixture
      - run: npm run mcp:eval:negative
      - run: npm run test:p5:postgres
      - name: Stop isolated services
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          cleanup_result=0
          if [ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-mcp.pid" ]; then
            mcp_pid="$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-mcp.pid")"
            node evals/public-mcp/start-isolated.mjs stop "$mcp_pid" || cleanup_result=1
          fi
          if [ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/public-mcp-supabase-isolation.json" ]; then
            if node ../../scripts/ci/public-mcp-supabase-isolation.mjs verify; then
              npx --yes --package=supabase@2.115.0 --package=@supabase/cli-linux-x64@2.115.0 supabase stop --no-backup || cleanup_result=1
            else
              cleanup_result=1
            fi
          fi
          "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/ci/self-hosted/host-port-lock.sh" release public-mcp-ports
          exit "$cleanup_result"

  untrusted-hosted:
    name: >-
      ${{ (((github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
               github.actor != github.repository_owner))))
          && 'public-mcp-behavior' || 'public-mcp-behavior-hosted-skipped' }}
    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && (
      (github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
        github.actor != github.repository_owner)))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/clued-cloud
    env:
      PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY: "true"
      MCP_BEARER_TOKEN: clued_bnd_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
      MCP_NEG_OWNER_A_TOKEN: clued_bnd_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
      MCP_SESSION_TOKEN: clued_ses_cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
    steps:

name: trivy

on:
  pull_request:

    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  trivy-trusted-self-hosted:
    name: >-
      ${{ (((github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
             (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
              github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
              github.actor == github.repository_owner)))
          && 'trivy' || 'trivy-self-hosted-skipped' }}
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'push' &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
       github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.actor == github.repository_owner)
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-docker-linux]
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Prepare persistent Trivy cache
        run: |
          TRIVY_CACHE_DIR="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/clued-trivy"
          mkdir -p "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR"
          echo "TRIVY_CACHE_DIR=$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Download vulnerability database through runner network
        timeout-minutes: 22
        env:
          TRIVY_IMAGE: ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9
          # When every download attempt fails, a cached database built within
          # this many hours is still used, with a warning. Older or missing
          # databases fail the job as before.
          TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS: "72"
        run: |
          # Only the pinned scanner and its cache use the runner network. No
          # checkout or Docker socket is mounted during this download. A host
          # loopback proxy is otherwise unreachable from the container bridge.
          db_dir="$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR/db"
          metadata_epoch() {
            value="$(sed -n "s/.*\"$1\" *: *\"\([^\"]*\)\".*/\1/p" "$db_dir/metadata.json" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"
            if [ -n "$value" ]; then date -u -d "$value" +%s 2>/dev/null || true; fi
          }
          now="$(date -u +%s)"
          next_update="$(metadata_epoch NextUpdate)"
          if [ -f "$db_dir/trivy.db" ] && [ -n "$next_update" ] && [ "$now" -lt "$next_update" ]; then
            echo "Cached vulnerability database is current; no download needed."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Trivy deletes the cached metadata before it downloads, so a failed
          # in-place download destroys the last good database. Download into a
          # per-run staging cache and swap it in only after success. The cache
          # is root-owned by the container, so file operations run in it too.
          staging="trivy-db-staging-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          in_cache() {
            docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint sh \
              -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/cache" "$TRIVY_IMAGE" -ec "$1" sh "$staging"
          }
          # Also drop staging caches abandoned by cancelled runs.
          cleanup_staging() {
            in_cache 'rm -rf "/cache/$1"
              find /cache -maxdepth 1 -name "trivy-db-staging-*" -mmin +120 -exec rm -rf {} \;' || true
          }
          trap cleanup_staging EXIT

          downloaded=false
          for repository in ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy-db:2 mirror.gcr.io/aquasec/trivy-db:2; do

              -e http_proxy -e https_proxy -e no_proxy \
              -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
              "$TRIVY_IMAGE" \
              fs --download-db-only --timeout 5m --cache-dir "/root/.cache/trivy/$staging" --db-repository "$repository"; then
              downloaded=true
              break 2
            fi
            sleep "$attempt"
            done
          done
          if [ "$downloaded" = true ]; then
            in_cache 'rm -rf /cache/db.previous
              if [ -d /cache/db ]; then mv /cache/db /cache/db.previous; fi
              mv "/cache/$1/db" /cache/db
              rm -rf /cache/db.previous'
            exit 0
          fi

          updated_at="$(metadata_epoch UpdatedAt)"
          if [ -f "$db_dir/trivy.db" ] && [ -n "$updated_at" ]; then
            age_hours=$(( (now - updated_at) / 3600 ))
            if [ "$age_hours" -le "$TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS" ]; then
              echo "::warning title=Trivy DB download failed::Using the cached vulnerability database built ${age_hours}h ago (limit ${TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS}h)."

            fi
            echo "::error title=Trivy DB download failed::Cached vulnerability database is ${age_hours}h old, over the ${TRIVY_DB_FALLBACK_MAX_AGE_HOURS}h fallback limit."

            echo "::error title=Trivy DB download failed::No usable cached vulnerability database."
          fi
          exit 1

        run: |
          # The previous step prepared the database; never re-download here.
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --skip-db-update --scanners vuln --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 /repo
      - name: Secrets
        run: |
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo" -v "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR:/root/.cache/trivy" \
            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --scanners secret --exit-code 1 /repo

            ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy:0.74.0@sha256:ee940acbf1f58ebadb42d01434ce4609530bf1b52536afbd1eee66cd7123c5c9 \
            fs --checks-bundle-repository ghcr.io/aquasecurity/trivy-checks:2 --scanners misconfig --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 /repo

  trivy-untrusted-hosted:
    name: >-
      ${{ (((github.event_name == 'push' && github.actor != github.repository_owner) ||

name: trivy

on:
